← Return to Kanji Path

Shared knowledge. Free tools.

Kanji Path is an independent study app. Its interface and source are provided under the MIT licence. Upstream educational data retains its original licences.

  • Kanji meanings, readings, school grades, stroke counts and frequency derive from KANJIDIC / KANJIDIC2, copyright Jim Breen and the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group. Project · CC BY-SA 4.0 and licence conditions. The bundled data is an adapted subset of 2,136 Jōyō kanji, serialized to compact JSON.
  • The JSON conversion is from David Luz Gouveia’s kanji-data (MIT). WaniKani-specific material is excluded. JLPT estimates originate with Jonathan Waller’s resources and are unofficial study aids, not official exam lists.
  • Stroke paths are from KanjiVG, copyright Ulrich Apel and contributors, under CC BY-SA 3.0. Modifications: select 2,136 kanji and 92 kana, extract ordered SVG paths, serialize as compact JSON. Adapted stroke data remains CC BY-SA 3.0.
  • 7,811 graded vocabulary entries derive from OpenJLPT, with level assignments and English glosses from Jonathan Waller’s JLPT resources and spelling/reading verification from JMdict (EDRDG). The adapted vocabulary dataset is CC BY-SA 4.0. Changes: retain vocabulary fields and alternate readings/spellings, retain sentence examples with source IDs and available furigana, omit parts of speech, merge matching original cards while preserving IDs and glosses. Full upstream notice · Pinned revision, source hashes and counts. Levels are unofficial estimates. Usage examples derive from Tatoeba contributors via OpenJLPT under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each example in the app links to its source sentence and contributors. Missing examples may be supplemented with original Kanji Path CC0 sentences. The adapted vocabulary dataset remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
  • N5–N1 grammar: 526 lessons from OpenJLPT, with original explanations, formation rules, notes, and examples. Field names and IDs are adapted; the dataset remains CC BY-SA 4.0. Pinned revision & source hashes · Download adapted grammar. Levels are unofficial estimates.
  • Conjugation and graded reading: Conjugation classes for 1,981 vocabulary entries derive from the pinned OpenJLPT / JMdict snapshot under CC BY-SA 4.0. Mapping and source hashes. Exercise logic is original app code. Ten original graded reading passages, glossaries, questions, explanations, and translations are provided by Kanji Path under CC0. Download reading material. Reading levels are estimates. Dictation uses existing attributed sentence examples and the device’s Japanese voice.
  • Basic kana, 127 original vocabulary entries and 40 original beginner practice sentences are provided under CC0. These examples are introductory material rather than a complete grammar curriculum.
  • Scheduling uses an SM-2-style calculation implemented locally. Shape matching compares user strokes geometrically against KanjiVG. Audio uses the device’s Japanese speech synthesis voice.

Snapshot date: 21 October 2026. See the source repository’s scripts/build-data.py, scripts/build-vocab.py, scripts/build-grammar.py and README for the refresh procedure. App data and participant progress are stored in the browser. Export backups regularly.
